evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 0 and no payload bytes.
The exact-current C2S master table identifies opcode 0 as IDLE_KEEPALIVE, FIXED 0, stock-client direct.
The class has no fields and no behavior beyond serializing the zero-payload keepalive packet.

The exact-current C2S master table identifies opcode 121 as REGION_LOADING_FINISHED_ACK, FIXED 0, stock-client direct.
Protocol authority classifies opcode 121 as region/UI lifecycle rather than gameplay state, matching this zero-payload acknowledgement object.
The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 202 and no payload bytes.
The exact-current C2S master table identifies opcode 202 as IDLE_LOGOUT_NOTICE, FIXED 0, stock-client direct.
A LocalLab runtime capture independently observed opcode 202 after extended idle time; missing framing for this fixed-zero packet caused the decoder to pause, matching the idle/logout lifecycle role.

The exact-current C2S master table identifies opcode 210 as REGION_CHANGE_ACK with FIXED 4 / i32_be payload.
Protocol authority classifies opcode 210 as region/UI lifecycle rather than gameplay state; the generated object has no constructor payload and always serializes the same acknowledgement constant.
